info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Correspondent Bank Directory API
info.description: This API allows users to update information in the Correspondent Bank Directory, which serves as a comprehensive list of banking institutions that facilitate international transactions. By utilizing this endpoint, financial institutions can modify entries to ensure accurate and current data is maintained. Typical users include compliance officers and bank administrators who require up-to-date information for operational efficiency and regulatory compliance. This API supports maintaining data integrity and enhances the collaboration and communication between banks in the global financial ecosystem.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific correspondent bank entry identified by its unique resource ID. Ensure that the request body contains all necessary fields that need to be updated.

requestBody.description: Updates the details of a correspondent bank in the external agency system. Ensure that all required fields are included in the request body and properly formatted.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the resource has been updated.
